normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Dune Our Thing,” a stunning beach cottage located in the authentic “Old Florida” community of Inlet Beach, surrounded by 13 acres of protected dunes. Located just a 1-minute stroll from pristine sandy shores, this elegantly crafted home boasts a private rooftop terrace with stunning Gulf Views, a fenced backyard with a gas grill, and access to a nearby community pool. Ideal for family vacations or group retreats. Learn more below... *** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Beach: Located only a minute’s walk from the turquoise waters and white sandRooftop Terrace: Spacious veranda with loungers, flat-screen TV, and seating for alfresco diningPrivate Backyard: Fully fenced-in space with a gas grill for evening barbecuesBeautiful Design: Classic shiplap finishes, quartz countertops, and rustic pine flooring throughoutFamily Friendly: Sleeps up to 10 guests with plenty of room to relax and unwindCommunity Perks: Enjoy access to the private pool and nearby scenic bike trail to Rosemary BeachBeach Bikes: Includes 6 bikes for guests to explore 30A and its surrounding areasEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "We had a great time at this Inlet Beach house. The views from the third floor terrace are incredible and we spent most of our time there. The beach access is super close and the pool is just steps away. Looking forward to returning next year." – Dana S.⭐ "Great location and easy access to the beach with 3 kids! We had 8 people and could’ve had more comfortably. 10 out of 10!" – Michalene B.⭐ "Pictures matched the high quality of this property. Exceptional customer service from the property management company. Highly recommend." – Tom L.*** LIVING AREAS ***“Dune Our Thing” offers bright, open living spaces that perfectly balance comfort and style. The ground floor features an airy layout, ideal for unwinding after a day at the beach. Classic shiplap walls, rustic wood accents, and pine flooring lend a timeless coastal charm to the space.Gorgeous open-plan design with coastal decorPremium seating, gas fireplace, and smart flat-screen TVSeamless flow into the kitchen and dining area3rd floor living room with plush sofa and smart TV*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Designed for foodies and families alike, the chef-inspired kitchen is equipped with modern quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a large island.Fully equipped chef’s kitchen with top-of-the-line appliancesLarge dining table for 6 coupled with breakfast bar seating 4Convenient access to the backyard grill for easy outdoor dining*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Relaxation continues outdoors with spaces that invite lounging and entertaining.Rooftop terrace with loungers, flat-screen TV, dining area for 6, and Gulf Views for daysGas grill in the fenced backyard for hosting meals alfrescoCommunity pool located steps from the home*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: ½ bathroom for guest’s convenience2nd Floor:Primary Suite 1: King-size bed, en-suite bath with walk-in shower and double vanityGuest Suite 2: King-size bed, en-suite bath with shower/tub combo, and Smart TV3rd Floor:Bedroom 3: King-size bed, coastal touches, and airy natural lightBedroom 4: Queen-over-queen bunk bed, ideal for families and extra guestsShared Full Bathroom: Shower/tub combination for 3rd-floor guests*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Discover the serenity of Inlet Beach, a picturesque coastal haven exuding Old Florida charm.Orange Street Beach Access: A 1-minute walk to regional handicap-accessible beach accessRosemary Beach: Only 0.8 miles away, featuring boutique shopping, fine dining, and live musicCamp Helen State Park: A 2-mile trip to explore Powell Lake and hiking trails30 Avenue & Shoppes at Inlet: Just 1 mile away for boutique shopping and dining*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.Construction is currently underway next to the property with an unknown completion date.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 97642STRO #: STR-097642
